svg.title: TOPAK G1 — The trusted base: a component enters only if its failure can only subtract, or its identity is issued
svg.desc: ADR-0045 (Accepted (genesis) 2026.10.01, Batch 22, confirmation required C2 and C4) declares the trusted base row by row: a fixed schema, three classes and a refusal, thirty-seven archetype rows in five groups (Annex A), and the reference's own declaration (Annex B). Since ratification three rows changed class (T-0045-27 B23, T-0045-14 B24, T-0045-24 B30 at the archetype) and seven were added: T-0045-31, the TLA+ Proof System (B25), with a certified configuration since B28; T-0045-32 to 34 for labels, handles and the tool list (A1, B34); T-0045-35 and 36 for the operator (A2, B34, provisional with ADR-0050); T-0045-37, the Lean kernel and toolchain (B36, with ADR-0053). Tables below are drawn in full from the record; where the reference has moved past Annex B (G10 §2.6, item 89), the row's note says so.
svg.text: TOPAK · G1

text.tspan: The trusted base: a component enters only if its failure can only subtract, or its identity is issued

svg.text: ADR-0045 (Accepted (genesis) 2026.10.01, Batch 22, confirmation required C2 and C4) declares the trusted base row by row: a fixed schema, three classes and a refusal, thirty-seven archetype rows in five groups (Annex A), and the reference's own declaration (Annex B). Since ratification three rows changed class (T-0045-27 B23, T-0045-14 B24, T-0045-24 B30 at the archetype) and seven were added: T-0045-31, the TLA+ Proof System (B25), with a certified configuration since B28;

T-0045-32 to 34 for labels, handles and the tool list (A1, B34); T-0045-35 and 36 for the operator (A2, B34, provisional with ADR-0050); T-0045-37, the Lean kernel and toolchain (B36, with ADR-0053). Tables below are drawn in full from the record; where the reference has moved past Annex B (G10 §2.6, item 89), the row's note says so.

Annexes A and B are declaration records under ADR-0023, ratified with the record as record-level entries; no deployment declaration has been written (G10 §8). Drafted by the assistant at the custodian's request; every drafter's choice settled by ratification.

text.tspan: A component is a row only if its failure can only subtract, or its identity is issued

svg.text: "Adds authority" has an exact meaning (Context, from ADR-0015: authority changes are exactly promotion and anchor issuance, “changes to the rules in force”). It is one of three things, and nothing else counts:
(1) an admit the rules in force would refuse · (2) a promotion the tally would stall · (3) an issuance the rules floor would reject.
Break-glass is not an addition: it happens within the rules in force.
Subtractions (ADR-0031 §5): a denial, a lapsed lease, an ended round, a revocation, an epoch fence, a stalled promotion, lost evidence.

text.tspan: The classes as a decision (§2; the order of the questions is the diagram's)
A component the deployment relies on

svg.text: A program, a device, a person, a store or a value (§1, Component).
Does any theorem take a premise from it (its Trusted for sentence, a premise node, §3)?
Relied on in practice and trusted for nothing. The row exists so every theorem premised on it is
computed void, not silently assumed (§3 rule 1). Examples: T-0045-13 gate runner, 22 host at
rung 0, 23 native tool, 24 a native Run tool's channel, 33 the label and destination declarations
Can the worst it yields be one of the three additions, rather than a subtraction (Failure can
produce)?
Its failure can only subtract. No proof, no key, no quorum; may be commodity substrate;
declared per deployment, reopens nothing (ADR-0034 §5's delegation test, met four times in the
corpus). Examples: T-0045-4 clock, 5 Kafka, 6 bundle engines, 7 archive, 24 a Wasm Run tool's
channel, delegated to T-0045-25 (B30).

text.tspan: Is its identity fixed, and did it enter by its own record?

svg.text: Both: identity fixed by an anchor issuance (a key under ADR-0025 §1 (c) or (f), a roster
under (a) or (b)) or by a promotion (an artifact named by digest), so replacing it is an
authority change; and it entered by a record of its own (ADR-0023's non-increasing-TCB
rule).
Trusted although its failure can add. Its residual is what its holder can do while the identity
stands. Model: ADR-0034 §2's verifier (T-0045-17). Examples: T-0045-1 replicas, 2 signature, 3
Cedar engine, 28–30 what runs, 31 the prover, 32 and 34 the label and handle machinery, 35 an
operator's identity provider, 36 its custody of its key.
Either it moves inside the verified object, where it is checked and not trusted, or the
design changes until its failure can only subtract. Applied in §6: trusted time refused; the
solver refused, and the proof checker that replaced it is a trust root (B24).
yes
yes
no
no
no: subtract only
yes, both

text.tspan: §1 · A row has a fixed schema

svg.text: What is trusted: a program, a device, a person, a store, a value
mechanism-boundary, substrate, toolchain or people (drafter's choice: ADR-0031 §6's three, plus ToO §13's people)
The premise the theorems take from it, in one sentence. This is the row's premise node in the theorem DAG (§3)
The axis and the rung range at which the premise is assumed. all for rung-0 rows
delegated, trust root or excluded (§2)
The worst thing the component's failure yields, named as a subtraction (ADR-0031 §5) or as one of the three additions above
For a trust root: the issuance (which ADR-0025 §1 item) or the promotion (which artifact, by digest) that names it. For a delegated row: the deployment declaration. For an excluded row: nothing
What remains when the component fails as named, stated on the face. Never empty; "none beyond the class" is a claim, stated as one
Custody is not a field: it is a pointer to a custody declaration (ADR-0025's annex or the deployment's), placed in Identity fixed by.

text.tspan: §6 · The rule applied to the 09.28 prioritization's eight candidates
Replicas: authentication and Byzantine replicas (G5, item 23)

svg.text: trust root (T-0045-1)
A Byzantine replica proposes admits no floor evaluated (ToO A9): an addition. Identity is the release's replica set, a promoted artifact. The residual is the forged admit;
mTLS is a delegated mitigation that prevents impersonation and not compromise. BFT is not required by this record
excluded (T-0045-23)
D-0034-3 already makes the principal Mediated. Nothing checks the tool; the row says so and every hermeticity premise is void for it
trust root (T-0045-16 to 18)
Their failure admits a rogue guest as Attested. Identity is P7's reference values in the promoted profile, and the verifier's issued key. The residual is on the face: side
channels and physical access, as ADR-0034 §6 states

text.tspan: Key custody and the anchor ceremony (G6)

svg.text: trust root (T-0045-8)
Key theft is a forged issuance. Identity is the anchor key set, item (c). The vault is delegated for availability and a trust root for secrecy; the row says which
A slow clock extends a break-glass approval, which preserves authority (ADR-0032 §2). No issuance fixes a clock's identity. The epoch-lapse stand-in is the subtract-only
answer, as the prioritization said; a time source enters only as a trust root with an attested identity, which no record has written
refused (finding 1); the checker that replaces it is a trust root
A false "implies" classes a relaxation as a tightening, and the relaxation then passes by promotion alone without the issuance ADR-0030 §5 requires. That is an addition,
and no key makes a solver honest. Either the routing check moves inside the verified object, or every floor change becomes two-key and the solver can only block.
ADR-0030 A1 (Batch 24) decided: a holds counts only with a proof a pinned checker accepted, so the solver is trusted for nothing and the checker is the row ⟨B24⟩
delegated (T-0045-7)
Its failure loses evidence, which subtracts legibility and never authority. The horizon and the audit read path are ADR-0028's rules, not the store's
not a row
Inside the verified object: the log is what the theorems are about. Service engineering, with no premise to declare

Also sorted: the gate runner (G8) is refused as delegated and admissible as a trust root once its evidence is signed under a key in issued rules (ADR-0025 §1 (f)); until then T-0045-13 is excluded and gate evidence is an operator's assertion (I18), now attributed to an operator and still an assertion

(G10 item 57). The rung-1 launcher is a trust root by ADR-0036 §5's own list (ADR-0036 Proposed); the launcher in the node is built and ADR-0033 A7 is ratified (B29; G10 item 35), and Annex B records its rung-1 instance of T-0045-19 and T-0045-20.
An undeclared row is false: a deployment sits below every theorem whose premises include it.
Type changes are rows: an ADR-0023 §4a degeneracy changes a row's class or rung range; §6b's field is a list of row ids. The
§6b amendment is owed; §6c, the declared rung per seat with the rows it rests on, is in force (ADR-0023 A1, B29) and the
declaration template is open (G10 item 64).
Membership per rung is the Rungs column; the per-round slice (ADR-0031 §6) is derived from the lease.
The binding table exists: spec/theorem-premise-binding.md (R6), 43 rows, last revised 2026.10.02 "pending" A7, which is
ratified since (B29). At R6, three rows no theorem cited: T-0045-7, 21, 26. Since B25 the rows with a proof module (38) rest on
T-0045-31 for the invariant, in place of T-0045-29 (ADR-0046 §5).
Behind the records (G10 §2.6, item 90): no rows for Labels, ToolList, Operators, Emergency, BreakGlass_A1 or
NonComposition_A1, so T-0045-32 to 36 are premises of no row yet.

text.tspan: §4 · Changing the table has a direction

svg.text: Removing a row, or trust root → delegated: a tightening; an ordinary promotion (archetype version at archetype level).
Adding a row, or delegated → trust root: a relaxation; its own record, and an issuance where it names a key (ADR-0034 added
A deployment instantiates rows; it does not add them. Trusting more is a §4a degeneracy with a D-row citing the T-row.
Annex A carries its archetype version; non-increasing TCB is checked row set against row set.

text.tspan: §5 · The verified object is the specification; what runs is a row

svg.text: Admit path, linked floor, Authentic, tally, rules floor, log: checked as specified (TLA+ with mutations at small constants, floor
gates, tests) and not trusted.
Since B25 (ADR-0046) the modules' invariants are proved with TLAPS, for every constant their assumptions admit: twenty-two
proof modules, 5,225 obligations (G10 §2.9). The prover is trust root T-0045-31, and TLC (T-0045-29) keeps the mutations and
witnesses.
Since B28 (ADR-0046 A1) a module may be certified: nineteen of twenty-two are, every SMT obligation backed by a proof the
checker of T-0045-14 accepted; RulesFloorNV_rev5, Confinement and Confinement_A1 are not (G10 §2.9, item 74). A certified
proof is not a verified one: the translation, normalization, LS4 and the checker stay trusted.
What runs is not the specification (R1): no refinement from TLA+ to Rust, an asserted build. Hence trust roots T-0045-28 to 30
for every deployment; a proof is of the module, not of what runs.
A debt, owned by ADR-0033 (R2): the rows leave when a machine-checked chain is cited. Stage 1, trace validation, exists (R4),
and is current with the tree: 82 traces, 1,007 steps, every step matching and every state keeping ConfinementRefinement.tla
's invariants (ADR-0033 A14; G10 §3). It found a race in lease expiry, fixed (A13). Stages 2–3 open (G10 item 56).
Kind: declaration (ADR-0023 §6a). Parameter: the trusted-base declaration, published → absent.
Premises falsified: every row (§3 rule 1). Theorems voided: every theorem with a premise node; the bottom of every axis,
holding only the mechanism constants.
Type changes: none declared, which is the failure.
The reference's position before Annex B, and every deployment's before it declares.

text.tspan: Annex A · The archetype's trusted base: thirty-seven rows in five groups (archetype version: the corpus at Batch 20, 2026.09.30; T-0045-31 added by dependent entry, B25; T-0045-32 to 36 by A1 and A2, B34; T-0045-37 by dependent entry, B36; T-0045-31's residual and instance amended by A3 and E1, B37)

svg.text: trust root (identity issued or promoted)
delegated (failure only subtracts)
excluded (trusted for nothing; premised theorems void)
struck by a dependent entry: the class it had before

text.tspan: 3 · The verified object's evidence (R1): what stands between the specification and a running deployment, and the tools that check it: T-0045-28 to 31, and T-0045-37 (B36)

the specification (mechanism/ against spec/ at the
reference)

hold, the running mechanism holds

An admit the specification refuses, which is every theorem at
once

mechanism/corpus-pins.sha256 names which spec it claims to follow
No refinement exists. The reference restates each TLC property as a test (mechanism/ §6) and asserts the rest; the 09.25 review grades the result Empirical. A debt
owed by ADR-0033 ⟨R2⟩: the row leaves the trusted base when a machine-checked refinement from the modules to the code is promoted with the release and an
ADR-0033 addendum cites it
TLC, and the constants each module was run at

"No error has been found" means the invariant holds over every reachable state of the
model at those constants, and a counterexample is one
all

A theorem taken as checked that is not, so a mechanism built to
it admits what the theorem forbids

2.19), pinned with the results the records cite by digest
Small constants: a property that holds at two principals and one epoch is evidence, not a proof (G5 §8). TLC's own soundness is unexamined here, as the Cedar engine's
is in T-0045-3; no mutation of TLC is run. Since B25 the constants bound the mutations and witnesses only: the thirteen invariants ADR-0046 proves rest on
T-0045-31, for every constant their assumptions admit ⟨B25⟩

cargo, every crate in Cargo.lock)

all

No reproducible build is declared, so the release digest fixes the artifact and not its provenance from the source. The signature primitive (T-0045-2) is the one crate this
record had already listed; the rest were not. A compiler the corpus does not inspect is the residual Thompson named
The TLA+ Proof System: tlapm, with its backends
(Z3, Zenon, Isabelle, LS4 for temporal logic)
toolchain
"All N obligations proved" means every obligation of the proof module is a theorem under
the module's assumptions; a proved Spec => []P holds of every behaviour of the module
all
trust root
A theorem taken as proved that is not, so a mechanism built to it
admits what the theorem forbids
Promotion: the prover binary's digest and version, printed in every proof results file
beside the digests of the modules proved, and pinned with the results the records cite
by digest
The prover's and each backend's soundness are unexamined here, as TLC's is in T-0045-29 and the engine's in T-0045-3; no mutation of the prover is run, and the
proof-checking backend (Isabelle) is not invoked on the SMT proofs. A proof is of the module, not of what runs (T-0045-28) ⟨B25⟩ Since B28 a proof module may be
certified (ADR-0046 A1; spec/proof-certification.md): cvc5 behind spec/smt-checked and the checker of T-0045-14 in place of Z3, Zenon's proofs checked by
Isabelle. For a certified module the SMT solver's soundness is no longer a premise; what remains is the prover's translation of an obligation into a query and its
normalization, LS4 for the temporal step of each theorem, and the checker. Eleven of the thirteen modules ADR-0046 cites are certified; RulesFloorNV_rev5 and
Confinement are not, and rest on the residual as first written ⟨B28⟩ Two known unsound cases ⟨A3⟩ ⟨B37⟩: the prover's translation can abstract a term it does not
translate (an ENABLED or a \cdot not expanded, a temporal formula) as a constant that drops any variable bound around it, after distributing [] over /\ and <> over \/
and moving a \A at the head of a [] body or conjunct, and an \E at the head of a <> body or disjunct, outward; and it names each term it abstracts, and each atom it
hands LS4, by a hash too short to be unique, of a print that does not tell a bound variable from a constant of its name, without checking that two terms of one obligation
get two names. Either way a false theorem can prove, and certify through SMT, through Zenon checked by Isabelle, or through Isabelle, and through LS4 by a collision or
a capture; the instance has both cases (Annex B). The rules of spec/proof-certification.md §10 are what is to keep a proof from the first case and from a capture,
and a second run over renamed sources (spec/proof-scan.sh) is what checks a module for a collision of the hash.

libleanshared), the elaborator and Lake that build
the terms it checks, leanchecker that replays

encodings against TLC's state graphs (R6), the models of apply against the reference's recorded traces (R4, R5); no TLA+ semantics in Lean and no Rust-to-Lean
translator was used. cedar-spec's own theorems are kernel-checked with the rest; its model's fidelity to the engine is T-0045-3 ⟨B36⟩

svg.text: The admit path, the linked floor, Authentic, the tally, the rules floor and the log: the verified object (§5). Grant seats (ToO A4): the promotion quorum is the authority, not something trusted for it; their independence is ADR-0035's rule and their judgment is what ADR-0024 counts. Cell Observers and correlators: principals whose findings only subtract (ADR-0007); collusion is ADR-0039 §5's declared gap and lineage independence its cover, neither a trust row. The Listener and the Reader: stages that add nothing to the trusted base
(ADR-0037 §2, ADR-0043 §1). Trusted time: refused (§6).

A2 (B34), the paragraph gains: Operators: principals, seated by a quorum, whose requests are typed and floored (ADR-0050); what is trusted of them is T-0045-35 and T-0045-36, and nothing of their judgment.
A1 (B34), narrowed for the Listener: delivery adds nothing, and labelling is T-0045-32.

No refinement. Stage 1 of the chain: the code's observed behaviours agree with an operational model of apply, step for step, on every tested path. What is still asserted is everything no test reaches, and the three oracles the model takes from

the trace (issuance validity, approval signatures, the parameter digest) ⟨R4⟩ ⟨B36⟩ Two pieces of the reference are proved in Lean of a transcription (ADR-0053): the admit decision, admit.rs's composition with the topak-floor wrapper,

proved to be a step of FloorComposition.tla's Decide on this row's premise and the module's own lift; and clock.rs's subtracting interval. That is evidence for those pieces, not a refinement of the mechanism; the row is unchanged. A model

of State::apply's seat and lease arms, every other check an oracle, is proved in Lean to refine Seats.tla at that module's constants, and the reference's recorded traces are replayed through it (ADR-0053 R4). That is the shape of stage 2 for

one module, and not the stage. A second model narrows that oracle with what Coupling.tla is about, and UnreadBounded is proved of it at any number of seats, directly and not by refinement. The premise table names the first model as a

route beside this row for the two Seats theorems, refines(Seats) (ADR-0053 R7): a deployment that declares the model faithful may carry those two without T-0045-28. No ADR-0033 addendum cites it as a stage. At G10 (ADR-0033 A14):

With T-0045-13, 16 to 21, 22, 23 and 24 excluded or absent, every theorem premised on confinement, on gate evidence, on hermeticity and on channel fidelity is void at the reference. What remains are the mechanism constants and the theorems whose premises

are the all rows above: the lease, the fence, composition, the tally, the coupling, seats and Observers. Every one of those rests on T-0045-28 to 30 ⟨R1⟩: they hold of the modules, and of the running reference only on trust in the refinement nobody has made.

The invariants of the thirteen modules ADR-0046 proves rest on T-0045-31 in place of T-0045-29, and their mutations and witnesses on T-0045-29 still ⟨B25⟩. That is the honest inventory ADR-0033 §1 describes in prose, with its one unstated premise now stated.
